title: Four Years of Ukraine Peace Talks Circle Back to Abu Dhabi
dek: Russia, Ukraine and the US plan a trilateral round in the first half of November, the first since the Iran war froze talks in March.
body: Talks since 2022 have produced prisoner swaps and a grain deal, but no ceasefire. The Kremlin calls November a "trial run."

panels.label: Moscow Says
panels.text: Putin says talks should settle long-term security for a final deal, not a "short" truce.

panels.label: Kyiv Says
panels.text: Zelenskyy says any deal needs strong security guarantees and 10 years of funding for Ukraine's army.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Moscow wants a final settlement on its terms; Kyiv wants guarantees first. At stake is the Donbas and who secures Ukraine after.
